stories.title: iRobot files for bankruptcy
stories.summary: iRobot, the 35‑year‑old maker of the Roomba robotic vacuum, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and will be acquired by its Chinese contract‑manufacturer Picea Robotics. Reddit sues Australia to exempt itself from kids social media ban
stories.summary: Reddit has sued Australia in its High Court to override a national ban that bars users under 16 from creating social‑media accounts, arguing that the law violates the implied constitutional freedom of political communication by restricting children’s ability to share political views that influence voters. The company also contends that its primary purpose is not user‑to‑user interaction—partly due to widespread anonymity—and that a read‑only mode may actually expose minors to more harm because logged‑in users can opt into content filters.
